description: ICE configuration. The first one is the reply to requestRtcConfiguration. Later ones are unsolicited mid-session credential refreshes (only sent to clients that advertised supportsLiveRtcRefresh).

fields.name: rtcConfiguration
fields.notes: Initial reply: the whole object is given to the RTCPeerConnection constructor. Refresh: only iceServers is read.

fields.name: rtcConfiguration.iceServers
fields.type: array of {urls: string | string[], username?: string, credential?: string}
fields.notes: Required for a refresh to have any effect: a refresh without iceServers is ignored.

notes: Which of the two it is depends on the connection phase, not on the content: the first rtcConfiguration after requestRtcConfiguration is the initial reply. Once the peer connection and the general message handler exist (happy_path step 6) any further rtcConfiguration is a refresh. A refresh can therefore never be handled before that point.
